scope: confirmatory; test-split hearings; labels are the majority of three blind passes of a language model, not a human judgment; every number is agreement with that annotation, not accuracy; nothing is chosen or tuned here
annotator: maioria de três passadas cegas de um modelo de linguagem (não humana)
question: trecho_sustenta
contrast: positive = correta; negative = parcial or incorreta
premise: the single evidence sentence of the UDV (evidence.text after normalize_whitespace), the production premise; one pair per UDV
domain_shift: E-A premises are four transcript chunks of about 630 characters each; E-B premises are one sentence. A result on one does not transfer to the other without this caveat
bootstrap: 5000 hearing resamples, seed 42, percentile interval; replicates with a single class are skipped

main_contrast.rule: primary verifier against cosine: paired delta of ROC AUC and AURC with the hearing-bootstrap interval and bootstrap p-value, and the DeLong test of the ROC AUC difference (unclustered, so it ignores that UDVs of a hearing are not independent; the bootstrap is the clustered test). Stated as better, no detectable difference or worse: better when the interval of the AUC delta excludes zero on the positive side and the bootstrap p-value is below 0.05

delong.rule: DeLong, DeLong and Clarke-Pearson (1988), structural components; items are treated as independent

added_questions.note: descriptive on E-B; the added-value family is the E-A validation one

descriptive_correct_or_partial_vs_incorr.rule: correta or parcial against incorreta (3 negatives): ROC AUC only, no interval or test
